sections.title: Quantitative Tools for the Analysis of Qualitative, Mixed-Methods, and Multimodal Evidence
sections.description: This course introduces students to AI-assisted qualitative research using a suite of no-code, privacy-conscious research tools for qualitative, mixed-methods, and multimodal sources of evidence. Through hands-on, face-to-face discussion, students will learn how to conduct qualitative coding, thematic analysis, sentiment and emotion analysis, data synthesis, and evidence-grounded interpretation without requiring programming knowledge. The course emphasizes methodological rigor, ethical AI use, data privacy, and the integration of qualitative, quantitative, visual, and computational evidence while preserving researcher interpretive authority. Students complete applied analyses using real-world datasets and develop practical skills that can be immediately transferred to research and professional settings.
